A method chosen after ACDC results are inspected must have exploratory status; do not claim confirmatory DG gains from target-informed changes.
acceptance: Protocol records source/target splits, metrics, one-pass evaluation and target-feedback limits | exploratory status for any ACDC-informed extension is explicit | README, ownership map and issue labels assign Person 1 to @khangcules10 and Person 2 to @MinhToan1001 | Leader freezes v1.0 after review

title: [A02] Repository skeleton, README and results policy
summary: Create src/, configs/, scripts/, tests/, docs/, research/, results/ and a README that explains protocol, repo map, deliverables and gates.
acceptance: All required folders tracked in git | README covers protocol, map, deliverables, gates | results/README.md defines naming and no-weights rule

title: [A03] Create 40-task issue backlog with owners, labels, milestones
summary: Create 40 GitHub issues (8/8/9/8/7 for Gates A-E) with assignee, labels, milestone and due date; keep a versioned CSV as source of truth.
acceptance: 40 issues exist on GitHub | every issue has assignee, labels, milestone and due date | CSV matches GitHub and is committed

title: [A04] Initial risk register with mitigations
summary: List GPU, dataset, licence and schedule risks plus technical risks; each needs a mitigation, a trigger, a contingency and an owner.
acceptance: Covers at least GPU, dataset, licence, time | every risk has >=1 concrete mitigation and a trigger | reviewed at each gate

title: [A05] CI green and main branch protection
summary: Ensure the pytest workflow passes on main and configure protection: PR required, 1 approval, no force-push, no direct push.
acceptance: CI green on main | PR + 1 approval + no force push enforced or documented as manual | branch naming documented

title: [A06] Gate A review and approval
summary: Review protocol, risk register, repo skeleton and the 40-issue backlog; resolve blocking comments and sign Gate A.
acceptance: All Gate A artifacts reviewed | blocking comments resolved | milestone Gate A closed and signed

title: [A07] Compute budget and environment note
summary: Document GPU model/VRAM, CUDA/PyTorch versions, measured smoke time and projected GPU-hours for one full baseline run.
acceptance: Environment documented | smoke time measured and full-run estimate recorded | fallback if GPU is lost is written down

title: [A08] PR/issue templates and branch conventions
summary: Add PR and issue templates that force issue link, validation, integrity checks and owner/due fields; document branch prefixes.
acceptance: PR template asks for issue link + validation + integrity | issue template exists for task and experiment | branch prefixes feat/a-*, feat/b-*, fix/*, exp/* documented

title: [B01] Dataset licence and access notes
summary: Document official sources, registration steps, terms of use, citation and what must never be committed for Cityscapes and ACDC.
acceptance: Both datasets documented with official URLs and terms | redistribution rules and citation recorded | reviewer confirms no licence violation

title: [B02] Download official data and record checksums
summary: Download Cityscapes and ACDC, verify file counts/folders and record SHA-256 checksums without committing raw data.
acceptance: Files match official counts and structure | checksums stored in a committed manifest | raw data stays under git-ignored data/raw

title: [B03] Canonical 19-trainId converter and tests
summary: Implement and test the verified mapping from raw labelIds/colour masks to Cityscapes trainIds 0..18 plus 255.
acceptance: Mapping matches the official table for all 19 classes + void | unit tests reject unmapped values | sample outputs match official *_labelTrainIds.png

title: [B04] Cityscapes train/val manifests
summary: Build Cityscapes train (2,975) and val (500) manifests with image,mask,domain,split and no duplicates.
acceptance: 2975 train + 500 val rows | no duplicated image/mask | validate_manifest passes with --check-files --check-labels

title: [B05] ACDC val manifest as a locked held-out set
summary: Build the ACDC val manifest: 406 images (fog 100, night 106, rain 100, snow 100), domain column filled, hash pinned.
acceptance: 406 images with correct per-condition counts | domain values are fog/night/rain/snow | manifest SHA-256 recorded and ACDC train/test excluded

title: [B06] Source visual audit and ACDC file-level QA
summary: Visually audit at least 20 Cityscapes train/val samples and verify ACDC file pairing/split metadata without opening or rendering ACDC image or label pixels before the frozen evaluation.
acceptance: Source audit checklist and class frequencies committed | ACDC manifest file counts/domain names/pairing verified from metadata only | no target image/label metrics inspected before model freeze

title: [B07] Source leakage and split check
summary: Check source train/val path and content-hash disjointness and verify the ACDC manifest is not included in any training or source-validation manifest.
acceptance: No Cityscapes train/val duplicate | no ACDC path in train/val manifests | script exits non-zero on leakage

title: [B08] Data contract validation in CI
summary: Add a CI job that validates a small committed fixture with --check-labels and fails on unmapped labels.
acceptance: CI job runs validate_manifest on a fixture | failing label values fail the job | documented in README

title: [C01] Synthetic smoke run and pipeline bug fixes
summary: Run the offline synthetic pipeline end to end (dataset, validate, train, evaluate), fix bugs and record runtime.
acceptance: pip install + pytest + smoke train + evaluate succeed offline | runtime and outputs logged | bugs fixed or ticketed

title: [C02] Freeze the baseline configuration
summary: Finalise SegFormer-B0 config: 512x512, AdamW 6e-5, 30 epochs, seed 42, ignore 255, batch size for the target GPU.
acceptance: Config matches protocol | batch size and VRAM documented | config SHA-256 recorded

title: [C03] 1% subset overfit sanity check
summary: Overfit roughly 30 Cityscapes images to prove the loss and metric can move in the right direction.
acceptance: Train loss drops and train mIoU rises | no NaN/inf | pass or fail recorded with evidence

title: [C04] Full Cityscapes baseline run (seed 42)
summary: Train the full baseline on Cityscapes train with checkpoint selection on Cityscapes val only.
acceptance: 30 epochs complete without manual intervention | best checkpoint chosen by Cityscapes val mIoU | history, config and hashes saved

title: [C05] Evaluation script with per-class and per-domain CSV
summary: Produce long-format metrics CSV (run,dataset,domain,class,iou,miou) from one command, reusable for Cityscapes and ACDC.
acceptance: One command writes the CSV | per-class IoU and mIoU match the confusion matrix | ACDC condition grouping supported

title: [C06] Metrics unit tests
summary: Test mIoU/IoU on perfect, all-wrong, empty-class and ignore-255 cases.
acceptance: Perfect prediction = 1.0 and all-wrong = 0.0 | 255 excluded from all counts | empty class excluded and listed

title: [C07] Baseline artifacts and checksums
summary: Package the best checkpoint hash, config, history and metrics CSV, and complete the run card.
acceptance: Checkpoint SHA-256, config and history recorded | metrics CSV committed | no weights or large files in git

title: [C08] Independent reproducibility rerun
summary: Rerun the baseline from a clean checkout or fresh environment and compare mIoU.
acceptance: Second run completes from documented commands | mIoU delta <= 0.5 | any difference is explained

title: [C09] Gate C review and baseline sign-off
summary: Review baseline numbers against the literature range, verify no leakage, and sign Gate C.
acceptance: Numbers plausible and traceable to CSVs | no ACDC signal used for selection | milestone Gate C closed

title: [D01] One-shot ACDC val evaluation
summary: After the baseline config and best checkpoint are frozen using Cityscapes only, evaluate the baseline on ACDC val in one inference pass; compute overall and per-weather metrics plus bootstrap intervals from the cached per-image predictions, then save the result before failure analysis.
acceptance: Only the frozen source-selected best checkpoint is used | one ACDC inference pass and its command/status are logged | metrics and hashes are committed before target failure analysis | no rerun for tuning

title: [D02] Per-domain/per-class DG table with bootstrap CI
summary: Generate mIoU for fog/night/rain/snow plus mean, per-class IoU and 95% bootstrap CI over images.
acceptance: Table covers 4 conditions + mean + 19 classes | 95% CI from 1000 resamples | generated by script, not hand-edited

title: [D03] Failure analysis per condition
summary: Inspect prediction grids (GT/pred/error) per condition and identify which classes and failure modes dominate.
acceptance: 4 condition grids committed | top-5 degraded classes listed | hypotheses tied to specific conditions

title: [D04] Literature matrix (5+ papers) and gap analysis
summary: Review at least 5 relevant papers and write a comparison matrix plus a gap specific to this DG protocol.
acceptance: 5+ papers with method/benchmark/metric/limitation | gap statement is specific and testable | no unsupported novelty claim

title: [D05] Propose exactly one modification with design record
summary: Choose one modification using literature and source-domain evidence. If ACDC failure analysis informs the choice, mark the extension as exploratory and do not present its ACDC score as confirmatory DG evidence.
acceptance: One change only, with hypothesis and cost | evidence and whether ACDC feedback informed the choice are recorded | exploratory status is required for a target-informed proposal | approved at Gate D

title: [D06] Implement the prototype
summary: Implement the change behind a config flag (default off) without touching evaluation code.
acceptance: Flag defaults to off | smoke test passes | evaluation code unchanged

title: [D07] Controlled ablation baseline vs modification
summary: Run baseline and the one approved modification with identical source data, training budget, seeds and evaluation code; report the extension as exploratory if ACDC results informed its design.
acceptance: Same source protocol, budget and seeds | per-domain table and CI committed | exploratory/confirmatory status justified from the pre-registration history | negative results reported without claiming an unsupported gain

title: [D08] Gate D review and claim check
summary: Verify the one-shot rule, ablation fairness and that every claim is backed by a committed CSV.
acceptance: One-shot rule verified | ablation uses identical settings | milestone Gate D closed

title: [E01] Inference demo CLI
summary: Ship scripts/demo.py: image or folder input, colour mask + overlay output, works on CPU with the released checkpoint.
acceptance: CLI runs on one image and one folder | outputs mask and overlay | usage documented and tested

title: [E02] Demo assets and usage documentation
summary: Capture demo outputs for clear/rain/fog/snow/night and add a usage snippet.
acceptance: 5 condition examples committed | README snippet added | files <= 2 MB

title: [E03] Final report
summary: Write method, data, protocol, results, ablation, failure analysis and limitations; every number traceable to CSV.
acceptance: All required sections present | numbers match committed CSVs | limitations and negative results included

title: [E04] Slide deck
summary: Prepare a 10-12 slide deck covering problem, protocol, results, ablation and limits.
acceptance: 10-12 slides | exported PDF | consistent with the report

title: [E05] README, results index and one-command reproduce
summary: Update README, add a results index, and provide commands that reproduce smoke + evaluation from a clean clone.
acceptance: Results index links all artifacts | commands work from a clean clone | no dead links

title: [E06] Release v0.1 with artifact manifest
summary: Tag v0.1, write release notes, upload the checkpoint as a release asset with SHA-256.
acceptance: Tag and release exist | checkpoint asset + hash listed | repo contains no data, weights or secrets

acceptance: Checklist complete | clean-clone smoke reproduces | Gate E signed and handoff notes written
